name: Royal Tombs of the Joseon Dynasty
description: Forty tombs of Korea's Joseon kings and queens lie across 18 sites, most of them in the countryside around Seoul. Each was set with a hill at its back, facing south toward water and distant ridges. Visitors walk up to grass-covered burial mounds guarded by stone figures of people and animals, with a T-shaped wooden shrine and a red-spiked gate nearby. Ancestral rites are still performed here.
